PROTECTION OF LAYOUT DESIGNS
(TOPOGRAPHIES) OF INTEGRATED CIRCUITS
REGULATIONS
Made under section 21 of the Protection of Layout-Designs (Topographies) of
Integrated Circuits Act
Commencement [8th December 2009]1
1 Short title
These Regulations may be cited as the Layout-Designs (Topographies) of Integrated
Circuits Regulations.
2 Interpretation
In these Regulations, useless the context otherwise requires:
“Act” means the Layout-Designs (Topographies) of Integrated Circuits Act
2002;
“Agent” means a law practitioner resident or having a place of business in the
Kingdom representing the applicant; and
“Registrar” means the Registrar for Industrial Property.
“Fees” the fees to be paid in respect of matter arising under the Act or these
Regulations shall be those specified in Schedule I.
3 Fees
The fees to be paid in respect of the matters arising under the Act or these
Regulations shall be those specified in Schedule 1.
to 2020 Revised Edition Page 5

Protection of Layout Designs (Topographies) of
CAP 17.03.01 Integrated Circuits Regulations
4 Form
(1) The forms referred to in these Regulations are those set out in Schedule II.
(2) The Registrar shall furnish copies of the printed forms free of charge.
5 Language of documents
Any document forming part of an application or submitted to the Registrar pursuant
to the Act or these Regulations and which is in the Tongan language or any language
other than English shall be accompanied by an English translation.
6 Signatures by partnerships, companies and associations
(1) A document purporting to be signed for or on behalf of a:
(a) partnership shall contain the names of all the partners in full and shall
be signed by all the partners or by any partner qualified to sign, stating
that the signs of behalf of the partnership, or by any other person who
satisfies the Registrar that he is authorized to sign the document;
(b) body corporate shall be signed by a director or by the secretary or other
principal officer of the body corporate, or by any other person who
satisfies the Registrar that the he is authorized to sign the document and
shall bear the seal of the body corporate; or
(c) association of persons may be signed by any person who satisfies the
Registrar that he is duly authorized.
(2) The Registrar may, whenever he deems it necessary, request evidence of
authorization to sign.
7 Representation
(1) The appointment of an Agent shall be by power of attorney which shall be
signed by the applicant or, it there are more than one, by each applicant.
(2) The power of attorney shall be filed together with the application.
8 Application for registration
The application for the registration of a layout-design shall be made in the form set
out in Form 1.
9 Withdrawals
(1) The application may be withdraw by written declaration submitted to the
Registrar.

Integrated Circuits Regulations CAP 17.13.01
(2) The application fees shall not be refunded if the application is withdrawn.
10 Marking application
(1) The Registrar shall, upon receipt mark on each document making up the
application:
(a) the actual date of receipt; and
(b) the application number consisting of the letters TO, stroke, the letter
LD, stroke, the last two digits of the year in which the initial papers
were received, stroke, and a five-digit number allotted in the sequential
order in which applications are received.
(2) The Registrar shall mark any corrections or other later filed documents
received on different dates, their actual date of receipt in the appropriate place
in Form 1.
(3) The application number allotted under sub-regulation (1) shall be quoted in all
communications concerning the application.
11 Notification
(1) The Registrar shall examine all applications in accordance with the Act.
(2) The Registrar shall notify the applicant, in writing, of his decision to grant or
to refuse the application and in the case of a decision to grant the application,
he shall require the applicant to pay the prescribed fee within one month from
the date of the notification.
12 Registration
The certificate of registration of a layout-design shall be issued in the form set out in
Form 2.
13 Entries in register
The Registrar shall enter in the register in respect of every layout-design, in addition
to the information required under section 10 of the Act:
(a) the address for service;
(b) the date on which the layout-design registration expired, was
surrendered or cancelled;
(c) any change in name or address;
(d) any change in address for service or ownership; and
(e) upon payment of the prescribed fee, a reference to a licence contract
which has been concluded and recorded under section 12(2) of the Act.

CAP 17.03.01 Integrated Circuits Regulations
14 Changes in ownership
A request made under section 12 of the Act shall be made to the Registrar in the
form set out in Form 3 and shall be accompanied by the prescribed fee.
15 Correction of errors
(1) The Registrar may correct any error of translation or transcription, clerical
error or mistake in any application or document filed, or in any matter
recorded pursuant to the Act or these Regulations.
(2) Corrections of errors may be made by the Registrar on his own initiative, or
upon receipt of a request in writing and accompanied by the prescribed fee.
(3) Corrections made shall be communicated in writing to all interested persons,
and, where considered necessary, shall be published by the Registrar.
16 Publication in the gazette
Particulars of layout-designs of integrated circuits and other proceedings under the
Act and any other information required to be published under the Act or these
Regulations shall be published in the Gazette.
